Les pêcheurs y gardent un poisson qui pi: The fishermen keep a fish here that stings the fingers of whoever touches it. The whole island comes to check, once, not twice.
Il polit la résine dorée, qui attire ens: He polishes the golden resin, which then attracts wisps of straw. Children leave with a pebble that does magic.
Par temps de brume, son aiguille ramène: In fog, its needle brings the boats back to the jetty. Since it arrived, nobody spends the night out at sea any more.
On y note quel bout attire et quel bout: Here you note which end attracts and which end repels. Beginners spend hours making a needle run away.
Une boule d'aimant sur laquelle on promè: A ball of lodestone over which you move a needle, like a little Earth. Everything is tried here before it is believed.
On charge la bouteille, on se tient par: The jar is charged, everyone holds hands, and the whole ring jumps. It is the most popular show on the island.
Une pointe de fer qui conduit l'éclair j: An iron point that leads the lightning down to the ground. On stormy evenings, people can finally stay at the market and watch the sky.
Un fil très fin qui se tord quand deux b: A very thin wire that twists when two balls repel each other. It turns a quarrel between scholars into numbers.
Des rondelles empilées, et pour la premi: Stacked discs, and for the first time a current that does not stop. It is the little flame from which the power station was born.
On fait tourner l'aimant, le courant naî: You turn the magnet, and the current is born in the wire. The steam from the hot spring finally has something to push.
Elle choisit la grosseur de chaque fil p: She chooses the thickness of each wire so that it does not heat up. Since then, no stall smells of burning any more.
Chaque maison y a sa branche. Quand une: Every house has its own branch on it. When a lamp burns out, the neighbours keep their light.
Des points et des traits annoncent les b: Dots and dashes announce the boats before they are seen. The port knows in advance who is coming, and with what.
On y fait sauter une étincelle d'un bout: A spark is made to jump from one end of the room to the other, without a wire. The students come out convinced the air is inhabited.
Elle tourne jour et nuit et allume les p: It turns day and night and lights the island's first bulbs. You also learn to count what each lamp uses.
Vent, soleil, source chaude : il faut pr: Wind, sun, hot spring: at every moment the island must produce what it demands. Someone keeps watch, even at three in the morning.
Un poste sur la tribune donne les nouvel: A set on the rostrum gives the news and the evening music. The farthest hamlets are no longer the last to know.
On y refroidit des métaux jusqu'à ce que: Metals are cooled here until the current flows through them without losing anything, and a beam of light cuts sheet metal to a hair's breadth.
Des pièces minuscules qui laissent passe: Tiny parts that let the current through, or not. Every machine on the island comes here to be mended.
Des milliers d'interrupteurs qui calcule: Thousands of switches that calculate without tiring. This is where the island keeps the memory of everything it has learned.
